title: Four Screens
pun: The brief, taken literally: the square cut in half twice, a different game in each quarter. Two of Emulia's accents alternate so every cell stays bright and the checker is what survives.
reads_as: a 2x2 checker of bright cells with a small sprite in each
risk: Measured: each sprite pixel is 1.19px at mdpi. The four sprites stop being four games and become texture; what is left is the checker, which no longer says NES.
